note: Passenger cars. The only class PyPSA-Wal has a fleet count for (`transport_data_*.csv` `number cars`), so the only one whose stock share can replace an exogenous `land_transport_*_share` today.
Vans. TIMES labels them `Road Freight`; PyPSA-Eur folds them into `total road` energy with no separate fleet.
TIMES labels them `Road Freight`. Note some carry a `TCAR…` process code — match on the description, never on the code prefix.
TIMES label `Road transport (public)`; urban buses and coaches.
`Bicycle electric` — lower-case `electric` in the description, hence case-insensitive matching.

Plug-in hybrid. Assigned to `ice` because PyPSA-Wal has no PHEV component: a PHEV split between the EV battery bus and the oil bus would need its own utility factor. Matched first — a PHEV description carries neither `Hybrid` nor `Electric` in this .vd, but the order makes that robust.
Non-plug-in hybrid: no grid connection, so it is an ICE as far as PyPSA is concerned.
Catch-all: diesel, gasoline, CNG, LNG, LPG, biodiesel, ethanol. → `land_transport_ice_share`
